name: Beyond Safe Shores
source:
Greenwich Royal Hospital, 17th of May, 1756

Dear reader, 

Greed plagues the monarchies, as they seek to invade, rewrite the borders and all of history as we know it. I summon you here today to join the cause, in the defense of the American colonies and the shores of England. As I know you shall make a suitable doctor for our royal navy. Will you be able to save the souls of the damned?

Your Obedient Servant, Sage

[From [url=https://sagedraws2472.itch.io/beyond-safe-shores]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
格林威治皇家医院，1756年5月17日

亲爱的读者，

贪婪困扰着君主制国家，因为它们试图入侵、改写边界和我们所知的所有历史。今天我召集你们一起加入保卫美洲殖民地和英格兰海岸的事业。据我所知，你会成为我们皇家海军的合适医生。你能拯救那些被诅咒的人的灵魂吗？

你听话的仆人，贤者
